formatted_reference:
Edward Tuite Dalton\.
*Descriptive Ethnology of Bengal*\.
Office of the Superintendent of Government Printing, Calcutta, 1872\.
P\.235 credits Babu Rakhal Das Haldar with compiling the tables, without identifying individual Juang speakers or elicitation sites\. Dalton chapter prose is separately attributed and does not receive the Haldar table dialect tag\. Dalton1866 AppendixF is a probable earlier partial witness, not a separately installed independent elicitation\. Samuells1856 is a distinct collection\. Acute accents and marked n are preserved literally, without inferring phonetic length or stress\. Residual \(s\.\) and source question marks remain in Notes; no donor edge is inferred\. Tumba retains qualified language attribution\. Original typography uncertainties remain explicit\.
URL: [https://commons\.wikimedia\.org/wiki/File:Descriptive\\\_Ethnology\\\_of\\\_Bengal\.pdf](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Descriptive\_Ethnology\_of\_Bengal.pdf)\.
